title: Update Report
description:
Updates specific fields of a report.



> [!NOTE]
> Do not use this endpoint to update advanced reports.

query.name: type
query.description: Pass the type of report to be created.

body.name: schedule
body.description: Pass the schedule details such as repeat type, start date and time, duration time, duration value, and repeat value.

items.name: repeat_type
items.description: Pass the frequency of the schedule.

items.name: start_datetime
items.description: Pass the start time of the report in epoch format.

items.name: repeat_value
items.description: Pass the interval for the schedule.

items.name: duration_value
items.description: Pass the time frame in days to include the data in the report.

body.name: name
body.description: Pass the name of the report.

body.name: query_key
body.description: Pass the key to sort data in the report.

enumValue.description: Data in the report is sorted based on the system created date.
Data in the report is sorted based on the system modified date.

body.description: Pass the list of columns of the report.

items.name: key

items.name: label
items.description: Pass the display name or label for the column.
